title: [CI] Hosted browser suite grows to the 90-minute ceiling and starves artifact acceptance
body:
## Verified capacity boundary, not a test-failure fix

The completed hosted main browser job in [run 37032274976](https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/actions/runs/37032274976/job/110924601837), subject `48da4ac330b43b8e2a8612d8dff160f2d380f05d`, took 86m42s. Its 766-case source step took **84m36s**, with only 5m24s beneath the existing 90-minute job ceiling before setup/build/artifact costs are included.

The later candidate [run 37039088544](https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/actions/runs/37039088544/job/110949744645), subject `3eeeddc2d276714fee6a7c8420270b78d2e49b3c`, declared 887 source cases but observed only **330 passes /38 failures** before cancellation; 519 had no completed observation, and artifact acceptance was skipped. The source step ran87m05s; whole job about90m47s. Logs and Actions step timestamps were read. Sharding cannot correct the38 failures and does not make this a healthy completed timing sample.

## Current offline collected coverage

At published integration `eeec3e844f`, the unchanged real suite wrapper collects **887 source tests /169 files** and **83 artifact tests /32 files**. Collection only; no browser was launched. Artifact collection used an actual local production build. The83-case artifact duration is **unmeasured**, and the old two-case artifact17s is not a forecast.

With `fullyParallel:false`, native shards collect446/441 cases but assign the known main file costs about61m36s versus22m29s. A cost-balanced whole-file draft instead collects325/562 cases in79/90 files. Historical main and fully observed passing candidate files are scheduling evidence;43 unmeasured files get explicit30s/case planning weight, never a test timeout or a predicted duration.

## Concrete proposal awaiting owner approval

[Reviewable balanced draft and simpler alternative](https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/blob/45a2f97dd6/docs/design/2026-10-02-browser-ci-sharding/README.md).

Preferred: two independent ubuntu-latest source runners, one worker on each, unchanged fullyParallel:false; artifact acceptance once in its own job; existing browser check becomes a fail-closed aggregate requiring complete source matrix success, artifact success and identical GITHUB_SHA subjects. Keep all original assertions, budgets, zero retries, narrow network-signature wrapper retry, fork guard, asset prerequisites, and always-upload evidence. No workflow/configuration/settings/CI rerun/cancel change has been performed. Activation is reserved to the owner under AGENTS.md reservation3.

Critical-path reduction is an inference, not measured speed. Three runner setups/downloads replace one and may queue; historical weights may drift; artifact83 may dominate. No2x speedup is claimed.

## Acceptance / pending boundaries

- Offline actual collection audit must establish exact source union with no duplication or split files, artifact coverage exactly once, unchanged metadata, and retained semantic gates.
- The draft producer must be omitted/mutated and the audit watched red, then byte-exact restored and green.
- Owner approval is needed before production workflow activation and scoped configuration-contract updates.
- After approval, a terminal hosted exact-subject run must report both complete source shards and83 artifact cases, with fail-closed browser aggregation and separate evidence. Current production defects remain separate work.

Fresh all-state searches: sharding; shard in:title; browser timeout; suite duration. Full existing #1089/#1008/#1084/#604 were read: they concern old self-hosted provisioning, specific assertion/environment failures, and past30-minute evidence gaps. This issue records current hosted suite growth near the90-minute capacity ceiling plus artifact starvation, with a proposed balanced whole-file execution shape. It is not a duplicate of those individual failures.
